entries.title: Galatians 6:1
segments: Brothers, even if a man should be caught committing a sin, you who are spiritually minded should, in a gentle spirit, help him to recover himself, taking care lest any one of you also should be tempted.

entries.title: Galatians 6:2
segments: Bear one another's burdens, and so carry out the Law of the Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 6:3
segments: If a man imagines himself to be somebody, when he is really nobody, he deceives himself.

entries.title: Galatians 6:4
segments: Let every one test his own work, and then his cause for satisfaction will be in himself and not in a comparison of himself with his neighbor;

entries.title: Galatians 6:5
segments: For every one must bear his own load.

entries.title: Galatians 6:6
segments: He, however, who is being instructed in the Message ought always to share his blessings with the man who instructs him.

entries.title: Galatians 6:7
segments: Do not be deceived. God cannot be mocked. What a man sows that he will reap.

entries.title: Galatians 6:8
segments: For he who sows the field of his earthly nature will from that earthly nature reap corruption; while he who sows the field of the spirit will from that spirit reap Immortal Life.

entries.title: Galatians 6:9
segments: Let us never tire of doing right, for at the proper season we shall reap our harvest, if we do not grow weary.

entries.title: Galatians 6:10
segments: Therefore, I say, as the opportunity occurs, let us treat every one with kindness, and especially members of the Household of the Faith.

entries.title: Galatians 6:11
segments: See in what large letters I am writing with my own hand.

entries.title: Galatians 6:12
segments: Those who wish to appear to advantage in regard to outward observances are the very people who are trying to compel you to be circumcised; and they do it only to avoid being persecuted for the cross of Jesus, the Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 6:13
segments: Even these men who are circumcised do not themselves keep the Law; yet they want you to be circumcised, so that they may boast of your observance of the rite.

entries.title: Galatians 6:14
segments: But, for my part, may I never boast of anything except the cross of Jesus Christ, our Master, through whom the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

entries.title: Galatians 6:15
segments: For neither is circumcision nor the omission of it anything; but a new nature is everything.

entries.title: Galatians 6:16
segments: May all who rule their conduct by this principle find peace and mercy--they who are the Israel of God.

entries.title: Galatians 6:17
segments: For the future let no one trouble me; for I bear the marks of Jesus branded on my body.

entries.title: Galatians 6:18
segments: May the blessing of Jesus Christ, our Lord, rest on your souls, Brothers. Amen.
